#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Minimal ADB UI helper for the mobile rubric evaluation."""
from __future__ import annotations

import os
import re
import subprocess
import sys
import time
from pathlib import Path

SERIAL = os.environ.get("ANDROID_SERIAL", "emulator-5554")
HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
EVID = HERE / "evidencia"
EVID.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
DUMP_REMOTE = "/sdcard/ui-eval.xml"


def adb(*args: str, check: bool = True, timeout: int = 30) -> subprocess.CompletedProcess:
    cmd = ["adb", "-s", SERIAL, *args]
    return subprocess.run(cmd, check=check, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=timeout)


def adb_shell(command: str, check: bool = True, timeout: int = 30) -> subprocess.CompletedProcess:
    return adb("shell", command, check=check, timeout=timeout)


def dump_ui(retries: int = 6, sleep_s: float = 1.2) -> str:
    last = ""
    for i in range(retries):
        r = adb("shell", "uiautomator", "dump", "--compressed", DUMP_REMOTE, check=False, timeout=40)
        if r.returncode == 0 or "dumped" in (r.stdout + r.stderr).lower():
            cat = adb("shell", "cat", DUMP_REMOTE, check=False, timeout=20)
            xml = cat.stdout or ""
            if xml.strip().startswith("<?xml") or "<hierarchy" in xml:
                return xml
            last = xml or (r.stdout + r.stderr)
        else:
            last = r.stdout + r.stderr
        time.sleep(sleep_s)
    raise RuntimeError(f"uiautomator dump failed: {last[:500]}")


def parse_nodes(xml: str) -> list[dict]:
    nodes = []
    for m in re.finditer(r"<node\b([^>]*)/?>", xml):
        attrs = m.group(1)
        def g(name: str) -> str:
            mm = re.search(rf'{name}="([^"]*)"', attrs)
            return mm.group(1) if mm else ""
        bounds = g("bounds")
        bm = re.match(r"\[(\d+),(\d+)\]\[(\d+),(\d+)\]", bounds)
        x1 = y1 = x2 = y2 = 0
        if bm:
            x1, y1, x2, y2 = map(int, bm.groups())
        nodes.append({
            "text": g("text"),
            "desc": g("content-desc"),
            "cls": g("class"),
            "rid": g("resource-id"),
            "clickable": g("clickable") == "true",
            "enabled": g("enabled") == "true",
            "focused": g("focused") == "true",
            "password": g("password") == "true",
            "bounds": bounds,
            "cx": (x1 + x2) // 2,
            "cy": (y1 + y2) // 2,
            "x1": x1, "y1": y1, "x2": x2, "y2": y2,
        })
    return nodes


def texts(xml: str) -> list[str]:
    return [n["text"] for n in parse_nodes(xml) if n["text"]]


def find_nodes(xml: str, *, text: str | None = None, desc: str | None = None,
               cls_substr: str | None = None, contains: str | None = None) -> list[dict]:
    out = []
    for n in parse_nodes(xml):
        if text is not None and n["text"] != text:
            continue
        if desc is not None and n["desc"] != desc:
            continue
        if cls_substr is not None and cls_substr not in n["cls"]:
            continue
        if contains is not None and contains not in n["text"] and contains not in n["desc"]:
            continue
        out.append(n)
    return out


def tap(x: int, y: int) -> None:
    adb_shell(f"input tap {x} {y}")
    time.sleep(0.35)


def tap_node(n: dict) -> None:
    tap(n["cx"], n["cy"])


def keyevent(*codes: str | int) -> None:
    joined = " ".join(str(c) for c in codes)
    adb_shell(f"input keyevent {joined}")
    time.sleep(0.15)


def hide_keyboard() -> None:
    # KEYCODE_ESCAPE / BACK can dismiss IME without leaving Expo if IME is up.
    adb_shell("input keyevent KEYCODE_ESCAPE", check=False)
    time.sleep(0.2)
    adb_shell("input keyevent 111", check=False)  # ESCAPE
    time.sleep(0.2)


def screenshot(name: str) -> Path:
    dest = EVID / name
    raw = subprocess.run(
        ["adb", "-s", SERIAL, "exec-out", "screencap", "-p"],
        check=True, capture_output=True, timeout=30,
    )
    dest.write_bytes(raw.stdout)
    return dest


def save_dump(name: str, xml: str | None = None) -> Path:
    if xml is None:
        xml = dump_ui()
    dest = EVID / name
    dest.write_text(xml, encoding="utf-8")
    return dest


def type_ascii(text: str) -> None:
    """Type using `input text`, mapping space to %s. Special chars sent as keyevents."""
    KEYMAP = {
        "@": "KEYCODE_AT",
        ".": "KEYCODE_PERIOD",
        "_": "KEYCODE_MINUS",  # not underscore; handled below
        "-": "KEYCODE_MINUS",
        "!": "KEYCODE_1",  # needs SHIFT
    }
    buf = ""
    def flush():
        nonlocal buf
        if not buf:
            return
        escaped = buf.replace(" ", "%s").replace("'", "\\'").replace('"', '\\"')
        adb_shell(f"input text '{escaped}'")
        buf = ""
        time.sleep(0.15)
    for ch in text:
        if ch == "@":
            flush(); keyevent("KEYCODE_AT")
        elif ch == ".":
            flush(); keyevent("KEYCODE_PERIOD")
        elif ch == "-":
            flush(); keyevent("KEYCODE_MINUS")
        elif ch == "_":
            flush(); adb_shell("input keyevent 59 69")  # SHIFT + MINUS sometimes underscore; fallback
            adb_shell("input text '_'")
        elif ch == "!":
            flush()
            adb_shell("input keyevent 59 8")  # SHIFT + 1
            time.sleep(0.1)
        elif ch.isalnum():
            buf += ch
        else:
            flush()
            # last resort: try input text of the single char
            adb_shell(f"input text '{ch}'", check=False)
    flush()


def clear_focused_field(n_dels: int = 48) -> None:
    keyevent("KEYCODE_MOVE_END")
    # burst deletes
    dels = " ".join(["67"] * min(n_dels, 24))
    adb_shell(f"input keyevent {dels}")
    if n_dels > 24:
        dels = " ".join(["67"] * (n_dels - 24))
        adb_shell(f"input keyevent {dels}")
    time.sleep(0.2)


def wait_text(substr: str, timeout: float = 20.0, interval: float = 1.0) -> str:
    deadline = time.time() + timeout
    last = ""
    while time.time() < deadline:
        try:
            xml = dump_ui(retries=2, sleep_s=0.6)
            last = xml
            joined = " | ".join(texts(xml))
            if substr in joined:
                return xml
        except Exception as e:
            last = str(e)
        time.sleep(interval)
    raise TimeoutError(f"did not find {substr!r}. last={last[:400]}")


def current_focus() -> str:
    r = adb_shell("dumpsys window | grep mCurrentFocus", check=False)
    return (r.stdout or "") + (r.stderr or "")


def login(email: str, password: str, timeout: float = 25.0) -> str:
    """Fill login via TAB (IME covers lower taps) and activate Ingresar with DPAD_CENTER."""
    xml = dump_ui()
    nodes = parse_nodes(xml)
    emails = [n for n in nodes if n["desc"] == "Email"]
    if not emails:
        raise RuntimeError("login form not visible")
    tap_node(emails[0])
    time.sleep(0.3)
    for _ in range(8):
        val = [n for n in parse_nodes(dump_ui()) if n["desc"] == "Email"][0]["text"]
        if not val:
            break
        adb_shell("input keyevent KEYCODE_MOVE_END")
        adb_shell("input keyevent 67 67 67 67 67 67 67 67")
        time.sleep(0.28)
    time.sleep(0.35)
    local, _, rest = email.partition("@")
    domain, _, tld = rest.partition(".")
    adb_shell(f"input text {local}")
    time.sleep(0.15)
    keyevent("KEYCODE_AT")
    adb_shell(f"input text {domain}")
    time.sleep(0.12)
    keyevent("KEYCODE_PERIOD")
    adb_shell(f"input text {tld}")
    time.sleep(0.3)
    adb_shell("input keyevent KEYCODE_TAB")
    time.sleep(0.4)
    xml = dump_ui()
    pw = [n for n in parse_nodes(xml) if n["desc"] == "Contraseña"][0]
    if not pw["focused"]:
        adb_shell("input keyevent KEYCODE_TAB")
        time.sleep(0.3)
    adb_shell(f"input text {password}")
    time.sleep(0.3)
    adb_shell("input keyevent KEYCODE_TAB")
    time.sleep(0.4)
    xml = dump_ui()
    btn = next(n for n in parse_nodes(xml) if n["desc"] == "Ingresar")
    if not btn["enabled"]:
        raise RuntimeError("Ingresar still disabled")
    if not btn["focused"]:
        adb_shell("input keyevent KEYCODE_TAB")
        time.sleep(0.3)
    adb_shell("input keyevent KEYCODE_DPAD_CENTER")
    return wait_text("Depositar", timeout=timeout)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    cmd = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else "dump"
    if cmd == "dump":
        xml = dump_ui()
        print("\n".join(f"- {t}" for t in texts(xml)))
        print(current_focus())
    elif cmd == "shot":
        p = screenshot(sys.argv[2] if len(sys.argv) > 2 else "shot.png")
        print(p)
    else:
        print("unknown", cmd)
        sys.exit(1)
